svg.title: Pulse diffusion on C6 and two triangles
svg.desc: Same 0 to 1 color scale for all eight panels. Numbers display node index and scalar feature. Layout is not a model input.

g.text: h0 = e1; P = (A + I)/3. Every panel uses the SAME scalar color scale [0,1].
Values: dimensionless. Circles contain node indices; below circles: h_k values.
